dedupeText: dark surrealist soundtrack cover pig mask impasto texture chiaroscuro grotesque heavy brushwork dark green coat menacing child figure positioned on the right facing left toward large display text fiery orange glow behind the figure contrasting with deep black shadows heavy impasto texture applied across both subject and background bold red title text anchored in the upper left quadrant combine surrealist subject impasto oil texture chiaroscuro lighting heavy grotesque typography for a dark cinematic aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: A dark, textured oil painting featuring a figure in a pig mask against a high-contrast, gritty background with bold, sans-serif display typography.
triggerTerms: dark surrealist oil painting with pig mask
excludeWhen: bright or cheerful themes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A menacing figure in a schoolboy's outfit wearing a realistic, weathered pig mask, holding a large butcher knife. The scene is rendered in a heavy, tactile impasto style with deep shadows and a glowing, fiery orange-red central light source that fades into black.
coreVisualRelationships: Figure positioned on the right facing left toward large display text
Fiery orange glow behind the figure contrasting with deep black shadows
Heavy impasto texture applied across both subject and background
Bold red title text anchored in the upper left quadrant
coreInvariants: The pig mask must appear as a physical object with visible straps
The background must exhibit thick, visible palette knife or brush strokes
The lighting must be dramatic chiaroscuro with a warm central core

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-length figure standing on the right third of the frame, scaled to nearly the full height of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pig mask and the pointing hand, highlighted by the central warm glow.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold red title, moves right to the pig mask, follows the figure's gaze/arm left, and drops down to the knife and bottom metadata.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense, textured dark space on the left and bottom, providing a canvas for secondary typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark umber providing the shadow base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Fiery orange and burnt sienna creating the central glow and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the primary title text and dark forest green for the figure's coat.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the glowing center and the pitch-black edges; high saturation in the red text and orange light.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy, warm, and dark tones

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning for the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and scales to maintain a brutalist, functional look.
graphicDevices: Hard drop shadows on text to separate it from the heavy background texture

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blunt, industrial feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary vertical presence and weight.
Captures the wide, modern grotesque structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark, surrealist oil painting with heavy impasto texture. On the right, a figure in a dark green coat and shorts wears a realistic pig mask. The figure holds a butcher knife. The background features a central fiery orange glow fading into deep black at the edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the title in the top left using a heavy, wide red sans-serif font with a slight black drop shadow. Add secondary metadata in white bold sans-serif at the bottom left and center left.

verificationChecks: Is the impasto texture visible and tactile?
Is the pig mask rendered with realistic detail?
Is the red title text bold and legible against the texture?
Does the lighting create a strong chiaroscuro effect?

adjustableVariables: Scale of the figure relative to the text
mustRedesign: Do not use smooth, digital gradients; maintain painterly texture
Do not use thin or elegant typography
postGenerationChecks: Check that the pig mask looks like a worn prop, not a cartoon.
Ensure the red text has enough contrast to be readable over the orange glow.
Verify the impasto texture is consistent across the entire canvas.
Confirm the figure's pose feels menacing and static.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surrealist Subject] + [Impasto Oil Texture] + [Chiaroscuro Lighting] + [Heavy Grotesque Typography] for a dark cinematic aesthetic.
